verdict.rationale: Cake exposes an MCP server so external AI clients (Claude, Codex, Cursor) can query the cap table in plain English, which enables AI-driven interaction with Cake data, but this is not a built-in assistant embedded in the Cake product itself — it requires a separate external AI client to connect. Missing for 10: a native, in-app AI assistant UI, evidence of task delegation (not just read-only Q&A), and any first-party assistant hosted directly inside Cake's interface.
